placements.quote: It was proposed to move the Goliath magnet from the West to the North Area and install it along with the WA97 detectors

summary.plain: A silicon pixel telescope entirely made of pixel detectors (about a million channels) placed near the target in the Goliath magnet, imaging the tracks of strange particles from lead-lead collisions.
summary.technical: NA57: pixel telescope of about one million channels (50 x 500 micrometre pixels) in the Goliath magnet moved from the West Area, conceptually similar to WA97.

technology.quote: The NA57 layout (Fig. 24) was conceptually similar to that of WA97.
technology.value: Pixel telescope of about one million channels in the Goliath magnet
